q: When the Munaafiqeen come to you
that you are certainly Allaah's Rasool.” Allaah knows well that you are His Rasool and Allaah testifies that the Munaafiqeen are liars.
(Although their statement is true, they are lying about the fact that they believe it.)
v.s: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, “We testify that you are the Messenger of God.” And God knows that you are His Messenger, and God testifies that the hypocrites are liars.
v.c: When the hypocrites come to you ˹O Prophet˺, they say, “We bear witness that you are certainly the Messenger of Allah”—and surely Allah knows that you are His Messenger—but Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are truly liars.

q: (when they swear that they are Muslims)
(to protect their hypocrisy from being exposed)
Evil indeed is that which they do.
v.s: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of God. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
v.c: They have made their ˹false˺ oaths as a shield, hindering ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah. Evil indeed is what they do!

q: This is because they had accepted Imaan
v.s: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.
v.c: This is because they believed and then abandoned faith. Therefore, their hearts have been sealed, so they do not comprehend.

q: When you look at them, their physical appearance appeals to you
and when they speak, you listen attentively to what they have to say
(because they speak eloquently and confidently). (However, despite their sturdy and confident appearance,)
They are like sticks leaning against a support
They are enemies so beware of them
(and never regard them as your friends).
May Allaah destroy them! Where are they wandering astray?
(They deviate further from Islaam with each passing day.)
v.s: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May God destroy them; how are they deluded?
v.c: When you see them, their appearance impresses you. And when they speak, you listen to their ˹impressive˺ speech. But they are ˹just˺ like ˹worthless˺ planks of wood leaned ˹against a wall˺. They think every cry is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah condemn them! How can they be deluded ˹from the truth˺?
v.h: All That Glitters Is Not Gold

q: When they are told, “Come forward and Allaah's Rasool ﷺ will seek forgiveness for you
(for your evil statements and actions against Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Muslims),”
they turn their heads around and you see them arrogantly
v.s: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of God will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
v.c: When it is said to them, “Come! The Messenger of Allah will pray for you to be forgiven,” they turn their heads ˹in disgust˺, and you see them ˹O Prophet˺ turn away in arrogance.

q: It is the same to them whether you
seek forgiveness for them or whether you do not seek forgiveness for them.
Allaah shall never forgive them. Verily Allaah does not guide the sinful ones.
v.s: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will God forgive them. Indeed, God does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
v.c: It is the same whether you pray for their forgiveness or not, Allah will not forgive them. Surely Allah does not guide the rebellious people.

q: (to the Ansaar during one of the expeditions),
“Do not spend on those with Rasulullaah ﷺ
(leave Madinah).” (However, they fail to realise that Allaah can sustain people without them because)
To Allaah belongs the treasures of the heavens and the earth but the hypocrites do not understand
v.s: They are the ones who say, “Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of God until they disband.” And to God belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
v.c: They are the ones who say ˹to one another˺, “Do not spend ˹anything˺ on those ˹emigrants˺ with the Messenger of Allah so that they will break away ˹from him˺.” But to Allah ˹alone˺ belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, yet the hypocrites do not comprehend.

q: say, “If we return to Madinah, the honourable ones among us
shall certainly exile the humiliated ones
(the Muhaajireen).” (However, they fail to realise that it is the true Mu'mineen who are truly honourable because)
All honour belongs to Allaah, His Rasool ﷺ and the Mu'mineen, but the Munaafiqeen do not know it.
v.s: They say, “If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honoured [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble.” And to God belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
v.c: They say, “If we return to Medina, the honourable will definitely expel the inferior.” But all honour and power belongs to Allah, His Messenger, and the believers, yet the hypocrites do not know.

q: O you who have Imaan! Let not your wealth and your children
(the duties that you owe to Allaah).
Those who do this are certainly losers
(who will lose the bounties of the Aakhirah).
v.s: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of God. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
v.c: O believers! Do not let your wealth or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. For whoever does so, it is they who are the ˹true˺ losers.

q: from what We have provided for you before death comes to any of you and then he says, “O my Rabb! Why do you not grant me respite
for a little while longer so that I can spend in charity and become of the righteous?”
v.s: And spend [in the way of God] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous.”
v.c: And donate from what We have provided for you before death comes to one of you, and you cry, “My Lord! If only You delayed me for a short while, I would give in charity and be one of the righteous.”

q: to any soul when its term
arrives. Allaah is Informed of what you do.
v.s: But never will God delay a soul when its time has come. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
v.c: But Allah never delays a soul when its appointed time comes. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
